questions.stem: The case below gives the figures. A patch touches 3199 lines and the reviewer must decide what global variable requires. What does global variable mean in this record?
questions.explanation: global variable: A global variable is declared outside functions and is accessible throughout the program, which can make reasoning and testing harder. Option D is correct: Accessible throughout the program. Option A is wrong because it mixes up global with local. Option B is wrong because it mixes up global with temporary. Option C is wrong because it assumes globals are constant.
